tools.name: load_csv
tools.description: Load a bounded CSV as sources without preset reports. Fields: order_id,region,currency,gross_cents; optional refund_cents,ticket_count. Rates map EUR/GBP to positive USD decimal strings. Workspace: 1–48 lowercase letters/digits/hyphens. Returns changed versions and native affected artifacts.

tools.name: prepare
tools.description: Return current typed handles, tool contracts and plan JSON schema for an analytics request; retain an immutable snapshot token for ten minutes. The caller chooses the plan.

tools.name: execute_plan
tools.description: Validate and execute the client's bounded analytics plan against its snapshot; return calculated report claims, actual calls and provenance. Never accepts code or SQL.

tools.name: inspect
tools.description: Read source versions and selected artifact receipts/currentness. Omit artifact_ids to list current artifact heads. Stale values are withheld from value; saved_value is historical.

tools.name: refresh
tools.description: Refresh 1–16 saved artifact IDs through actual Hydra dependencies; returns replacement IDs, receipts and actual tool-call count. No model, fallback retrieval or arbitrary execution.
